idea: An AI study planner app for JEE aspirants that adjusts the timetable after every mock test

invented_stats.where: growth.objection:We already pay ₹15,000/month for coaching; why pay ₹499 more?

strategist.problem: The exact moment a JEE aspirant finishes a 3-hour mock test and sees a score of 120/300, they panic because their static, pre-made study plan from a coaching institute does not reflect their specific weak chapters, leading to wasted hours studying strong topics instead of the ones dragging their rank down.
strategist.target_customer: Parents of Class 11 and 12 students in Tier 1 and Tier 2 Indian cities with a household income above ₹10L who are already paying ₹15,000+ monthly for coaching and will pay a small premium for a digital tool that objectively optimizes their child's 10-hour daily study routine.
strategist.mission: To convert every mock test score into an instantly updated, AI-driven study timetable that eliminates guesswork for JEE aspirants.

competitors.name: Physics Wallah (PW)
competitors.differentiator: PW offers static video lectures and general doubt-solving, but does not dynamically restructure a student's daily hour-by-hour schedule based on the specific error patterns of their latest mock test.

competitors.name: Unacademy
competitors.differentiator: Unacademy provides live classes and test series, but the study plan remains a generic syllabus tracker; it does not use AI to adjust the remaining weeks' schedule in real-time after a single test performance.

competitors.name: Manual Excel/Notion Templates
competitors.differentiator: Students currently use static spreadsheets that require 2 hours of manual data entry and analysis after every test; our app automates this analysis and schedule generation in under 10 seconds.

scope_cuts: No video lectures or content creation: We are a planner, not a coaching institute. We do not teach the syllabus; we only tell the student what to study next based on their mock test data.
No live doubt-solving or community features: Building a real-time chat or forum requires moderation and high server costs. The core value is the automated schedule, not peer interaction.

No Android native app: We will ship a mobile-responsive web app first. This saves 2 weeks of development time and avoids the 2-week Play Store review process, allowing us to start collecting UPI payments via a simple link immediately.

stack.name: Next.js (App Router)
stack.why: Server-side rendering for fast timetable generation and SEO for landing page, runs on free Vercel/Netlify tiers.

stack.name: Supabase
stack.why: Postgres database for storing mock test scores and generated schedules, plus built-in auth for student/parent accounts.

stack.name: Razorpay
stack.why: Native UPI and card support for Indian parents, essential for collecting monthly subscriptions via payment links.

stack.name: OpenAI API
stack.why: GPT-4o-mini for parsing mock test error patterns and generating dynamic study schedules in under 10 seconds.

stack.name: shadcn/ui + TailwindCSS
stack.why: Rapid UI development for the dashboard and schedule view without custom CSS, ensuring mobile responsiveness for web-first launch.

ai_tools.name: Cursor Pro
ai_tools.why: AI-assisted coding to build the Next.js frontend and Supabase backend logic in 15 hours/week.

ai_tools.name: v0.dev Pro
ai_tools.why: Generates React component code for the study planner dashboard directly from text prompts.

mvp_features: Mock Test Score Input & AI Schedule Generator: User enters chapter-wise scores from a mock test; AI analyzes weak areas and generates a 7-day hour-by-hour study timetable prioritizing high-weightage weak chapters.
Parent Dashboard & Payment Link: A simple view for parents to see the child's current schedule and a Razorpay payment link for the monthly subscription.
Weekly Schedule Refresh: Automated re-generation of the next week's plan based on the previous week's completion status and new mock test data.
first_10_steps: Register a .com domain on Cloudflare Registrar and connect it to a Netlify free tier account for deployment.
Create a Supabase project, enable email authentication, and set up tables for 'users', 'mock_tests', and 'schedules' using the Supabase SQL editor.
Run 'npx create-next-app@latest jee-planner' and install TailwindCSS and shadcn/ui to scaffold the frontend.
Integrate the OpenAI API key into a Next.js API route to parse mock test JSON input and return a structured 7-day study plan.
Build the 'Mock Test Input' form using shadcn/ui components, allowing users to enter chapter-wise scores and total time spent.
Develop the 'Schedule Dashboard' page to display the AI-generated timetable in a mobile-friendly grid view.
Create a Razorpay account and generate a payment link for a ₹499/month subscription, embedding the link in the parent dashboard.
Deploy the Next.js app to Netlify and test the full flow: login -> input score -> generate schedule -> view payment link.
Share the app link in 5 WhatsApp groups of JEE aspirants and 2 parent groups, asking for 10 free trials in exchange for feedback.
Monitor OpenAI API usage and Netlify bandwidth, ensuring costs stay under ₹1,000/month before scaling to paid users.

Parent dashboard with schedule visibility and progress tracking

revenue_targets.notes: 2 parents from initial WhatsApp group trials convert to paid after 2-3 weeks of evaluation and social proof from peers
6 new parents via referrals from first 2 users and 2 college fest demos
12 new parents via Instagram ads targeting Tier 1/2 cities and alumni network

key_assumptions: Parents of JEE aspirants in Tier 1/2 cities with household income >₹10L will pay ₹499/month for a tool that saves 2 hours of manual planning per week
2 paying customers by Day 30 is achievable through 10 free trials in 5 WhatsApp groups with a 20% conversion rate over a 3-4 week evaluation period
OpenAI API cost per customer is capped at ₹50/month assuming 10 mock test analyses per month at ~₹5 per analysis
Marketing budget of ₹2000/month covers Instagram ads and WhatsApp group promotions without exceeding bootstrapped constraints

channels.name: Warm Referral via Coaching Institute Network
channels.tactic: Ask the founder's JEE coach or a trusted senior mentor to introduce the tool to 2 specific parent WhatsApp groups (50-100 members each) with a 1-sentence endorsement. Founder then sends personalized DMs to 10 parents in those groups daily who have active Class 11/12 students. Volume: 20 DMs/day, 400 unique parents reached/month.

channels.name: Instagram Reels for JEE Parents
channels.tactic: Post 3 Reels/week targeting 'JEE 2026 preparation' and 'Coaching alternatives' with a hook: 'Stop wasting 2 hours analyzing mock tests.' Use 3 relevant hashtags (#JEE2026, #JEEPreparation, #CoachingInstitute). DM every commenter with a free sample schedule. Volume: 12 Reels/month, 50 DMs/week.

first_10_customers: Identify 50 parents of Class 11/12 students in the founder's local coaching institute or college hostel WhatsApp groups.

Send a personalized voice note to 10 parents daily: 'Hi [Name], I built a tool that auto-generates a study plan after every mock test. I'm giving 10 parents a free 1-week trial this week. Want me to send a sample schedule for your child's last test score?'
For the 5 parents who reply, manually create a sample 7-day schedule using their last mock test score (input: score, weak chapters) and send it via PDF within 2 hours.
Follow up with a 5-minute phone call to explain the schedule logic and offer the ₹499/month plan for the next 30 days.
Ask each of the first 5 paying parents to forward the WhatsApp group invite to 2 other parents in their institute's parent group.
Collect 2 short video testimonials from the first 5 users to use in Instagram Reels and WhatsApp posts.
growth.cold_message: Hi [Parent Name], I built a tool that turns your child's mock test score into a 7-day study plan in 10 seconds. I'm offering 10 parents a free 1-week trial this week. Can I send you a sample schedule for your child's last test score?

objections.objection: We already pay ₹15,000/month for coaching; why pay ₹499 more?
objections.response: Coaching gives you lectures, but not a dynamic schedule. Our tool saves 2 hours/week of manual analysis and ensures your child studies weak topics first. It's a ₹499 premium for objective optimization, not another course.

objections.objection: How do I know the AI schedule is accurate?
objections.response: I'll generate a free sample schedule for your child's last mock test score. Compare it with your current plan. If it doesn't clearly prioritize weak chapters, don't pay. No risk, no commitment.

critic.verdict: The plan is strategically sound and technically feasible for a student founder, correctly identifying the high-intent pain point of JEE aspirants and leveraging low-cost infrastructure. However, the financial model is fragile due to a critical mismatch between the aggressive marketing spend and the conservative revenue projections, which creates a negative cash flow trap in the early months. The growth strategy relies on a high-CAC channel (Instagram ads) that contradicts the bootstrapped, campus-first constraint and the low price point of the product.
critic.biggest_risk: The plan burns ₹2,000/month on Instagram ads to acquire customers at a CAC of ₹1,000, while projecting only ₹1,000 MRR in the first month, resulting in a net loss of ~₹7,000 in Month 1 that depletes the ₹10,000 starting capital before product-market fit is established.
